You may find yourselve in a state of fragile surrealism. Please do not attempt to adjust your consciousness. Just crack open a dram of this 1990, 35 year old Glenturret that has been rescued from oblivion in the nick of time and marvel at its soft, generous waxiness, its phantasmagoric mineral properties, its luscious white and yellow fruit notes and its general old school glory. If you should find yourself floating serenely and saying 'I have massive hands', please remember that nothing is unreal and everything will just be ok in the end... somehow.
